name: Down the Line
summary: Down the Line is a daily word game. Every day there are eight prompts, such as “Name a dog breed” or “Name a city that’s also someone’s first name”, and you type any answer you can think of. Answers are rated by how many people would say them, and rarer answers score more: common, uncommon, rare and very rare. Your train travels further down a Tube-style line the rarer you go. Each prompt also hides a golden ticket, a real answer that almost nobody thinks of, which comes with a fact about it. Unusual answers that aren’t on the list are checked as you play, so creative ones still count. Results can be shared, and friends can start a group to compare scores each day. There’s also an archive of past lines, an Unlimited mode with extra prompts, and a Streamer vs Chat mode where a streamer plays against their Twitch chat. A new line comes out every day.
